metadata.description: PRISMA inclusion/exclusion criteria for Ge'ez-Script NLP survey

peer_reviewed.note: Conference proceedings (ACL, EMNLP, NAACL, etc.) or peer-reviewed journals

target_language_mentioned.description: Paper must mention Ge'ez-script language or script

foundational_tool_contribution.description: Paper must contribute foundational NLP tool/dataset/algorithm

tool_development_central.description: Tool development must be central to paper, not auxiliary
tool_development_central.note: Not just applying existing tools to downstream tasks

year_range.description: Paper published within specified year range

non_peer_reviewed.description: Technical reports, blog posts, unpublished theses, preprints without peer review

no_target_language.description: Does not mention Amharic, Tigrinya, Ge'ez, or related script

no_nlp_focus.description: Linguistics, history, or computational analysis without NLP tool contribution

no_tool_contribution.description: Paper mentions Ge'ez-script languages but contributes no foundational NLP tools

downstream_only.description: Applies existing tools to downstream task (MT, sentiment analysis) without foundational contribution

duplicate.description: Same paper already screened (different version, preprint, etc.)

decision_tree.step_1: Is paper peer-reviewed? If NO → EXCLUDE (non_peer_reviewed)
decision_tree.step_2: Does paper mention Amharic, Tigrinya, Ge'ez, Ethiopic, or Fidel? If NO → EXCLUDE (no_target_language)
decision_tree.step_3: Does paper describe foundational NLP tool/dataset/algorithm? If NO → EXCLUDE (no_nlp_focus)
decision_tree.step_4: Is tool development/evaluation central to paper? If NO → EXCLUDE (downstream_only)
decision_tree.step_5: Does paper fit year range (2016-2026)? If NO → EXCLUDE (out_of_date)
decision_tree.step_6: Is this a duplicate of already screened paper? If YES → EXCLUDE (duplicate)
